speak.title: Role-play: a promotion or a free evening?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You want to offer your employee a promotion. It means longer hours and no more free evenings. Explain why they are right for the job. Ask what worries them, and try to find a solution.

b.text: You'd like the promotion, but you volunteer three evenings a week and your work is not the whole of your life. Explain what matters to you and ask for changes.

phrases: Thanks, I'm really pleased you asked.
I'd love the job, but I'm worried about the hours.
What matters most to me is my life outside work.
We're hoping you'll take it on.
Could we try fewer evenings for a trial period?
I'll think it over and let you know.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you agree, and who gave way more?
